title: Great, modestly priced laptop
body: This has proven to be a great, modestly priced laptop that easily addresses my computing needs. It's proven to be plenty fast enough for my needs (not a gamer) which includes standard computing tasks, virtual meetings, a fair bit of online work with OneDrive managing photographs, etc. I'd like the image quality/clarity of the camera to be a bit better but it's adequate. I'd also like a better placed and larger Delete key and a pilot light in the Num Lock key (like the Caps Lock key). It's too easy to turn off. The Power button is also oddly placed. None of this would stop me from buying it again though.

title: Highly recommend
body:
I'm impressed with this laptop. It's fast, thin and light and the graphics on the 16 inch screen are really nice.  WiFi 6 connectivity is an improvement over previous generations. 

Setup was fairly simple and went quickly. After updating Windows 11 and removing a few pre-installed apps that I didn't want or need, installing apps went quickly and smoothly as well. Those apps (MS-Office, Chrome browser, utilities, etc.) and the standard Windows apps open quickly, run fast and smooth and I have not crashed no matter how many windows are open. 

Only criticism thus far is that it took longer than expected or initially promised to customize and ship and it would be nice if it had an Ethernet connection and an SD card slot. 

I highly recommend this laptop.
